title: Unit 26 Consolidation

items: Review deber for a duty and deber de for a guess.
Review haber de, tener que and hay que, and the modal verbs for guessing.
Read a text about Ernesto Sabato and his novel Sobre héroes y tumbas.
I can tell deber, deber de, haber de, tener que and hay que apart.
I can rank a guess as less or more sure, from puede to tiene que.
I can read a short text about Ernesto Sabato and his novel Sobre héroes y tumbas.
sections.title: Can you do this?

goal: Review deber, deber de, haber de, tener que and hay que, the modal verbs for guessing, and read a text about Sabato and Sobre héroes y tumbas.
